title: ChatGPT cites the most-cited articles and journals, relying solely on Google Scholar's citation counts. As a result, AI may amplify the Matthew Effect in environmental science

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting ChatGPT to generate scientific review articles with references for various environmental science subdisciplines, and then analyzing the extracted references based on their Google Scholar citation counts, publication dates, and journal prestige to measure the disproportionate selection of highly-cited, established works.
Evaluating the publication dates of the references generated by ChatGPT to determine if the model exhibits a preference for older, more established academic papers over recent literature.
